text:
Amelia Chen: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need concrete owners/timelines for the remediation items that require test additions (regression suites, prompt sets, load tests, chaos drills).
Raj Patel: Agreed. Noticed a recurring pattern in the IO eviction incidents; looks like sequences with long-prefix KV hits + burst traffic. We should add a targeted regression and a short chaos drill to simulate bursts.
Sam Rivera: I can fold the regression into the CI matrix if we define the harness and expected pass/fail thresholds. Prefer a dedicated job name like `regression/kv-eviction-burst` so it's easy to track.
Monica Li: I'll own prompt-set curation — the postmortem flagged 6 prompts that exposed tokenization/cutoff edge-cases. I'll push sanitized versions to the evals repo and tag them with the incident id.
Amelia Chen: Thanks. Proposed owners: Amelia -> overall triage & rollout; Raj -> load/chaos tests; Monica -> prompt sets; Sam -> CI integration + dashboarding. Sound good?
Raj Patel: Sounds good. Timeline suggestions: quick triage + draft tests in 72h, full CI integration in 2 weeks, scheduled chaos drill in next monthly ops drill.
Sam Rivera: 72h for draft harness works. For CI: need a PR with the harness + sample job and a performance baseline file. I'll require a performance baseline before enabling the job for every PR.
Monica Li: Will open PR to `github.com/redwood-inference/evals` with the prompt set + README. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals/pull/342 (placeholder).
Amelia Chen: I'll create an umbrella remediation ticket RW-4821 and subtasks: RW-4821.1 (regression harness), RW-4821.2 (prompt set), RW-4821.3 (chaos drill), RW-4821.4 (dashboard + alerting). Assigning RW-4821.1 -> Sam, RW-4821.2 -> Monica, RW-4821.3 -> Raj, RW-4821.4 -> Amelia.
Raj Patel: For the chaos drill, propose a scoped plan: 3 runs at low/med/high arrival patterns, KV cache warm/empty permutations, verify fallback behaves and latency SLOs hold. I can sketch a runbook.
Sam Rivera: For CI thresholds: recommend we set token-latency median and 95th pct boundaries, and failure if median regresses >10% or 95th >15%. We'll keep a baseline artifact in `s3://redwood-evals-baselines/kv-eviction/` and the job will compare.
Monica Li: Prompt set notes: remove PII, add expected gold outputs for the cases that exposed hallucinations, and include explicit deterministic instruction variations.
Devex-Bot: New ticket created RW-4821 by Amelia Chen — https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RW-4821
Amelia Chen: Action items recap: 1) Monica: PR with prompt set + gold outputs (72h). 2) Sam: Draft CI harness + baseline (72h). 3) Raj: Chaos runbook + initial load test scripts (72h). 4) Amelia: Umbrella ticket + weekly check-in scheduling.
Sam Rivera: I'll also add a lightweight dashboard tile to the ops console for the regression job status and last-baseline comparison.
Raj Patel: Can we make the chaos drill non-disruptive to prod? Suggest we run against a mirrored staging cluster with production-like traffic replay.
Amelia Chen: Yes — dedicated staging replay. Raj, coordinate with infra to reserve replay window. Add infra owner to the RW-4821.3 subtask.
Monica Li: One more: let's include a small sample of synthetic long-prefix sequences (length distribution from recent incidents) in the regression. I'll export and attach stats in the PR.
Sam Rivera: Note for integration: add a `--ci-mode` flag to the harness so we can run faster (shorter seqs) in PRs and full sequences in nightly runs.
Amelia Chen: Great. Who wants to volunteer to lead the first chaos drill when ready? Raj?
Raj Patel: I can lead the drill runs and capture the after-action notes.
Amelia Chen: Perfect. I'll schedule the first triage sync tomorrow 10:30am and set recurring weekly check-ins until RW-4821 is closed.
Monica Li: Thanks — I'll start the prompt scrub and post the PR link in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
Sam Rivera: I'll start on the harness and ping infra for baseline storage.
Devex-Bot: Reminder set: weekly cadence for RW-4821 check-in starting 1735338600
Amelia Chen: Thanks team — keeping the thread here for visibility. If you hit blockers tag @Amelia and drop the blocker details.
Raj Patel: Copy. I'll drop the initial chaos runbook draft here by EOD.
